title: Forcing $\mathbfΣ^1_1$-Separation on $ω_1^{ω_1}$
summary: We prove that it is consistent that every two disjoint boldface $\mathbfΣ^1_1$ subsets of $ω_1^{ω_1}$ can be separated by a boldface $\mathbfΔ^1_1$ set. The forcing starts from $L$ and preserves CH and therefore also $ω_1^{<ω_1}=ω_1$.
